AT-62

A340E(Others) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION  -  DIRECT CLUTCH

71.2 mm
(2.803 in.)

AT8338

(c)  Check that the distance from the direct clutch end to the
forward clutch end is 71.2 mm (2.803 in.).
If the distance is less than the above value, parts may
have been assembled incorrectly, check and reassemble
again.
